{"id":1858544195,"question_id":3892,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766029888,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1858544195/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock V","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic: \n    using ll = long long;\n    long long byrec(vector<int>&prices , int k , int i , int type)\n    {\n        //base case\n        if(i >= prices.size())\n        {\n            if(type == 0) return 0;\n            return INT_MIN;\n        }\n\n        //first we split our ways into 3 parts -> buy , shortsell or skip the transaction\n\n        //dont take the stock\n        ll exclude = 0 + byrec(prices , k , i+1 , type);\n\n        //buying the stock and then selling\n        ll include = 0;\n        if(k > 0)\n        {\n            if(type == 1)\n            {\n                include = prices[i] + byrec(prices , k-1 , i+1 , 0);\n            }\n            //shortselling and then rebuying\n            else if(type == 2)\n            {\n                include = -prices[i] + byrec(prices , k-1 , i+1 , 0);\n            }\n            //neutral transaction\n            else \n            {\n                ll buy = -prices[i] + byrec(prices , k , i+1 , 1);\n                ll shortsell = prices[i] + byrec(prices , k , i+1 , 2);\n                include = max(buy , shortsell);\n            }\n        }\n\n        return max(include , exclude);\n    }\n\n    long long maximumProfit(vector<int>& prices, int k) {\n        return byrec(prices , k , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-v","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1351}
